thread.title: Wall Street starts year on strong note; Nasdaq ends above 7,000

author: Reuters
title: Wall Street starts year on strong note; Nasdaq ends above 7,000
text: NEW YORK (Reuters) - U.S. stocks rose in the first session of the new year and the Nasdaq closed above 7,000 for the first time on Tuesday as investors were optimistic that 2018 will bring more gains for the market. The Nasdaq, driven by gains in Apple (AAPL.O), Facebook (FB.O), Amazon (AMZN.O) and Alphabet (GOOGL.O), breached 6,000 in April of last year and closed above 5,000 in 2015 for the first time in 15 years.
